findings.title: Batch discovery reparses the whole TXD once per native texture
findings.what_this_is: The manifest already obtains a validated ordered TextureIndex for each CMB member, then requests a read-only decode for every native. The shared texture function constructs the entire index again for every request. Specification measurements have the same repeated work with a smaller 64-selection limit.
findings.problem: For N native records, one manifest performs N+1 full dictionary index traversals and constructs N+1 byName maps and native metadata slices. Existing pixel-work accounting does not charge this repeated structural work; zero-dimension or unsupported natives still repeat it. The new byName map shortens selection only after each full reparse.
findings.measurement_qualification: TotalAlloc is cumulative Go allocation, NOT peak resident memory. Valid-case totals include PNG encoding and pixels; the zero-dimension cohort isolates repeated parsing from pixel/PNG work. Timing is a single modest local run, not a throughput guarantee. No exhaustion or data corruption is claimed.
findings.minimal_fix: Enhance the existing texture owner to reuse the already validated, source-bound TextureIndex for batch/specification decode. Keep standalone callers validating their own exact bytes; fresh artifact readback must reparse modified bytes. Preserve duplicate selector and metadata-error precedence, chunk bounds, source association and byte-preservation checks. Do not add a second parser, per-native handler, global cache or general framework.
findings.if_skipped: Large admitted dictionaries repeatedly allocate and traverse unrelated native metadata. For the 1024-record invalid cohort, a 168 KB input causes over 1 GB of allocation without decoding a single pixel; the 100000-row batch ceiling allows this overhead to repeat across members.

reproduction.instrumentation: Only private texture_index.go adds a package counter increment at indexTextures entry. Only private texture_manifest.go imports runtime and records the counter plus MemStats.TotalAlloc on stderr immediately before normal output encoding. Both instrumented source files are preserved and hashed below. Production source was never changed.
reproduction.read_only_contract: All probe invocations are dry-run manifest commands with no --apply or --output. They exercise texture(data, native.Name, nil, nil, policy): nil replacement and nil rectangles. Invalid zero-dimension cases fail before any pixel decode. Valid native records are byte copies of the first native (alpha) in the frozen examples/asset-specification/source.txd, changing only fixed-width names plus required dictionary/CMB counts/extents.
reproduction.uninstrumented_crosscheck: Both 1024-record inputs were rerun with a fresh unmodified frozen-source binary. Complete stdout bytes equal instrumented stdout exactly; stderr is empty. The valid cohort decodes every 16x16 raster with the same frozen source pixel hash.
reproduction.extra_files: Exact source CMBs and hash-pinned profiles for every size, unmodified/instrumented binaries, both instrumented source files and structured receipts are retained and hashed below.

findings.root_status: Root acknowledged the reproduced lead and described a possible existing-owner enhancement. No live implementation or closure was inspected or credited by this audit.

scope_challenges.result: The two new named functions have distinct actual responsibilities. Existing palette generation mutates colors and rendering changes pixels; neither can reasonably own unchanged-pixel statistics. Single-TXD authoring and streamed multi-member assembly have different source lifecycles. No unnecessary function was established, but the batch still fails to reuse its validated index (A031-1).

Static challenge covered explicit Python dotted-I lower/IGNORECASE differences, strict edge/opacity/fraction thresholds, self-inclusive neighborhood, row runs, and source-error unknown-score handling. No second functional counterexample established; independent 33+3 score and 34 PNG oracle claims were read, not rerun in full.

Pillow12.3 gray16/tRNS compatibility is a finite documented normalization, while raw encoded PNG exports remain unchanged. No new decoder/helper or unsupported claim of PNG-spec-correct semantics. General PNG/APNG/color-management behavior was not independently exhaustively exercised.

Exact authored joins refuse missing or ambiguous matches before publication. Full source hash/stat/path identity and profile byte recheck precede existing exclusive output/readback writer. Own 9-entry example dry/apply/overwrite probes preserve bytes and deterministic bundle; no hostile namespace or concurrent mutation claim.

Exact LINE count reuses measured Shape.LineWidths and sums per-page len-1; trailing/empty lines remain counted and PAGE contributes no LINE. Unknown measurements stay unknown, wrap+count refuses, and mismatch status keeps other diagnostics. Null/absent constraints deliberately remain unconstrained per contract; no separate token scanner.

Reference-bound audits compose existing references and inspect owners, require matching IDs and every declared site readable/convergent, then demand one complete file-backed mapping equal to the declared observed window. Recorded reference values remain distinguished from executed/live consumers. No new resolver or loose first-target fallback identified.

Roadmap arithmetic and 292 scoped pins match frozen content. The ordinary manifest review binds 15 current candidate pins; its pre-promotion roadmap pin is explicitly different and disclosed. All three proof contracts and its review hash match. Milestone accounting does not promote a family or retire historical scripts.
